result: Directory scan fails on a non-ASCII legacy short alias; fixture tests blocked before LFN lookups.
explanation: The legacy FCB contains UTF-8 bytes c3 a9. picofs component() refuses bytes >= 127 and scan() discards the partial directory snapshot. The 77-byte entry matches the unique Unicode test file. Other USB and SD reads remain operational; broken transport latch was not set.
limitation: Unicode LFN fallback currently works only when the legacy short alias itself is supported ASCII. Non-ASCII aliases are not supported by the current driver.
next_step: Isolate the Unicode file and its Mac metadata sidecar in their own fixture directory on the Mac; retain this failure for regression work, then complete the ASCII boundary tests.
